set.body:
Outcome

Separate two estimands currently conflated by the crossnobis name.

Acceptance

- Identity-precision crossvalidated squared distance is named and typed directly.
- Crossnobis requires a certified whitening or precision capability and retains its provenance.
- At least two lawful independent partitions are required.
- Negative unbiased estimates remain representable.
- Feature normalization and physical units are explicit.
set.title: P4B.4: implement identity-precision distance and explicit noise-whitened crossnobis
